storyline.real: Ralf Schumacher leads from his first pole. Michael stops a lap after him at the first round of stops and comes out ahead, Montoya, on a longer first stint, leads twice before his engine fails, and Michael wins by 10.4 s from Ralf for his 50th Grand Prix win.

hidden.label: Win without a single push lap

eras.briefing: Magny-Cours, 2001, 21 laps in. Your brother Ralf leads from pole in the Williams, about two and a half seconds ahead of you; Coulthard's McLaren is third. Two stops is the norm here, and Ralf will stop first. Get your Ferrari out of the stops ahead of him and win.
